name: Hoverboard
instruction: Design a hoverboard meant for quick commutes. It should have a flat platform for standing and two wheels on either side. Add small LED lights on the front and back for visibility.

Shape accuracy: The hoverboard features a flat platform for standing.
There are two wheels positioned on either side of the platform.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The wheels are proportionate to the flat platform.
The hoverboard design maintains a balanced look.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The wheels are positioned correctly on either side of the platform.
The flat platform is elevated above the ground level.
The LED lights are mounted at the front and back of the hoverboard.
Object distance and contact: The wheels do not interfere with the flat platform.
The LED lights are clearly visible and do not obstruct any other components.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
The design includes a flat platform, two wheels, and LED lights as instructed.
